_comment: CONTINUITY - the second b0b.dev film, built by scripts/build-intro-collage.py --spec scripts/film-continuity.json.
Its argument is the report's own (Section VII's apex clause, IX's continuity of government, XVI's clocks):
power that lasts is written into instruments that outlive the people who sign them. The refrain
("the X ended; the Y did not") makes the pattern audible; the finale plots every dated point and then
refuses to join them - the anti-map guardrail, a shared timeline is not a chain. The killed trope passages
(dynasties, "families who own the central banks") are not re-added in any form; the bloodline answer is
named and refused in part VIII, as Section VII does.
EVERY PANEL CARRIES ITS SOURCE. Licences read from each source's own metadata: PD, CC0, CC BY (credited on
screen), and Library of Congress 'no known restrictions' for three U.S. News & World Report photographs.
Typed document cards quote the record verbatim and cite it on screen.
LIVING-PERSON FLOOR APPLIED TO PICTURES: faces are of the dead (Elizabeth I, Clive, George V, Eisenhower,
Volcker, Kelly Johnson, Khrushchev) or rooms, buildings, documents and aircraft. REFUSED: two Prince Bernhard
portraits (photographer living; the museum's CC0 not explained), a Kissinger portrait (gift terms unread),
a Rockefeller/Burns still (partial third face), an Israeli/US F-35 formation (reads as a statement), the
Nuremberg dock still and pleas film (the Funk line was cut: his BIS board seat is attributed only).
NOT USED: the only farewell-address film found is a community upload of unknown provenance, so the
narrator quotes Eisenhower over the public-domain reading copy instead.
Lines fact-checked 23 Sept 2026 (session scratchpad film2-facts.md): EIC war/coin powers came under Charles
II, hence 'in time'; Resolution V 'put aside' by 1948; PPD-40 text not released; Proclamation 7463 continued
8 Sept 2026 (91 FR 57773); Iraq AUMFs repealed in the FY2026 NDAA, 18 Dec 2025; Vanguard quoted verbatim;
Lockheed SIPRI #1, $64.7bn, 2024 data.

lines.text: London, the last day of 1600. A queen signs a charter, and a company is born that will outlive her by two hundred and seventy years.
lines.say: London, the last day of sixteen hundred. A queen signs a charter, and a company is born that will outlive her by two hundred and seventy years.

lines.text: In time it won the right to make war, coin money and hold courts. When the Crown took it over in 1858, its armies became the Queen's, and its offices carried on as the Raj.
lines.say: In time it won the right to make war, coin money and hold courts. When the Crown took it over in eighteen fifty-eight, its armies became the Queen's, and its offices carried on as the Raj.

lines.text: Build something that is not a person, and it does not have to die.
Basel, 1930. A bank for central banks opens to settle German reparations. The reparations ended in 1932. The bank did not.
lines.say: Basel, nineteen thirty. A bank for central banks opens to settle German reparations. The reparations ended in nineteen thirty-two. The bank did not.

lines.text: At Bretton Woods in 1944 the Allies recommended its liquidation at the earliest possible moment. By 1948 the recommendation had been put aside.
lines.say: At Bretton Woods in nineteen forty-four, the Allies recommended its liquidation at the earliest possible moment. By nineteen forty-eight, the recommendation had been put aside.

lines.text: Today sixty-three central banks are members.

lines.text: Continuity of government is not a rumour. It is a line of directives, each signed to replace the last, from Eisenhower to now, under both parties.
Mountains were hollowed out for it. A bunker for the whole of Congress sat under a resort hotel for three decades, until a newspaper found it.
It was switched on once: the eleventh of September, 2001. The text of the directive in force today has not been released.
lines.say: It was switched on once: the eleventh of September, two thousand and one. The text of the directive in force today has not been released.

lines.text: Climb the pyramid and the names thin out into rules: asset managers, central banks, sovereign funds. Vanguard is owned by its own funds.
The seat at the top is real, load-bearing and empty. Hand it a family or a bloodline and the analysis is over. That is the oldest way this research goes bad.
